subject: Marketbook: offer economics and procurement path — post-call recap
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Lee <michael.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketbook: offer economics and procurement path — post-call recap

Thanks for taking the call this morning, Michael — recap below from our discovery + immediate asks so procurement can triage. I left Ben and Karthik on for the pricing/mapping side.

Quick summary (what we heard)
- Primary use-case: interactive generation (customer-facing features) + background embeddings for search/ranking.
- Expected steady-state volumes: ~120M — 300M input+output tokens / month (spikes up to ~450M in big campaigns).
- Embeddings: ~20M–30M vectors/month.
- Latency SLO: 200–400ms P50 on gen paths.
- Preferred models: quantized Llama-2 family (cost-sensitive) plus one higher-quality variant for key flows.
- Procurement path: you indicated preference for AWS Marketplace private offer if legal/procurement approves.

Budget and unit economics guidance (you gave):
- Monthly budget target (approx): $60k/mo base, potentially up to $90k/mo in Year 1.
- Directional target unit-econ: ideally below $100 per 1M tokens for general gen workloads after marketplace fees/discounts; embeddings target ~$0.40–$0.50 per 1k vectors.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Ben to map these volumes into a marketplace-friendly set of line items (PPU equivalents) and propose a target $ / 1M tokens by model variant (quantized vs standard) for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace private offers.
2) Michael / procurement: confirm that AWS Marketplace private offer is the desired route (vs direct invoice). If yes, confirm any PO timing constraints or internal review windows.
3) I'll attach the token workbook we used in the call — please update if our assumptions on peak/seasonality are off.
4) If marketplace path is confirmed, we'll produce a draft private-offer template and a DocuSign-ready PO for faster turnaround.

Attachments: token_estimates.xlsx (workbook used in call)

Thanks — Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

From: Michael Lee <michael.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketbook: offer economics and procurement path — post-call recap

Camila — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few details from our side and adding procurement.

Confirmed / clarifications:
- Budget band: looks like we can commit to a runway of $60k–$90k/mo for the first 6–9 months. We could consider a larger commit if unit price supports it.
- Preference: AWS Marketplace private offer (to match our procurement policy).
- Procurement window: procurement needs ~30 business days to review a private offer and confirm our internal PO routing.

I attached the same token_estimates.xlsx with two small edits on peak/seasonality — see tab "Ops assumptions."

Can you and Ben provide: (a) a marketplace line-item mapping with $/1M token equivalents we can insert into the private offer, and (b) whether Redwood will create the private offer on our behalf or we need to initiate a request through AWS? Also interested in any multi-year commit discounts you typically offer (12/24 month) and how those change the PPU.

Thanks — Michael

--
Michael Lee
CloudOps Lead | Acme Analytics
michael.lee@acme-analytics.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Lee <michael.lee@acme-analytics.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-01T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketbook: offer economics and procurement path — post-call recap

Michael — appreciate the edits on the workbook. Below is a pragmatic mapping we use when creating marketplace private offers. These are draft target unit prices (PPU-equivalents) expressed as $ / 1M tokens or per-1k embeddings, inclusive of standard marketplace fees we bake into the listing. We'll note any additional pass-through fees separately in the offer.

Draft unit-price mapping (Marketplace private-offer friendly)
- Redwood API — Generation (standard model): $120 per 1M tokens
- Redwood API — Generation (quantized model): $88 per 1M tokens
- Redwood API — High-quality variant (larger context / better quality): $180 per 1M tokens
- Redwood API — Embeddings: $0.42 per 1k vectors

Notes and rationale:
- These numbers assume continuous workload batching and KV caching improvements; higher committed volumes or a 12/24-month reserved capacity commitment can reduce the quantized tier to ~$70 per 1M tokens (12-month commit) — we can show a commit ladder in the private offer.
- Marketplace take: we model ~10–15% effective take in the back-end price; the prices above are what your ledger would see as the PPU line items (i.e., what procurement will pay on the AWS invoice).
- Billing cadence: monthly by invoice through AWS if you accept the private offer path. If you prefer direct invoice, we can offer slightly different net pricing (will show side-by-side).

Next steps from Redwood:
1) I'll prepare a draft private-offer template (attached) pre-populated with the line items above and the deal_id RDW-ACME-202706.
2) If you confirm marketplace path, we can either create the private offer ourselves (we have a marketplace ops SLA) or collaborate so procurement triggers the request — whichever you prefer.
3) Once we have procurement sign-off on the line items, we'll generate a DocuSign PO for signature to accelerate setup.

Attaching: redwood-private-offer-template.pdf (draft)

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0147

From: Michael Lee <michael.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketbook: offer economics and procurement path — post-call recap

Ben / Camila — this looks good. Procurement confirms AWS Marketplace private offer is preferred.

We are inclined to start on the quantized generation plan with the potential to move to reserved commit in Q4 if the usage ramps as expected. Procurement requests:
- Please provide the draft private-offer in the AWS Marketplace format we can upload to our review queue (your attached PDF is fine for now).
- Share the DocuSign-ready PO lines so we can route internally (procurement needs the exact invoice line items).

Can we schedule a contract handoff with procurement on Friday, June 4 at 10:00am PT? Procurement says 30 business days review is likely once the private offer is in their queue.

If you can share the DocuSign link and the final private-offer bundle before EOD Thursday, we'll have procurement start an early read.

Thanks — Michael

--
Michael Lee
CloudOps Lead | Acme Analytics
michael.lee@acme-analytics.com | +1 212-555-0199
